parameters.subject: =📝 New post → publish to Substack: {{ $json.title }}
parameters.html:
={{ `

New Cortisol+ blog post

${$json.title}

${$json.contentSnippet || ''}

View live on cortisolplus.com →

To publish on Substack (30 seconds):

  1. Click here: Open Substack new-post editor
  2. Title: ${$json.title}
  3. Copy the HTML below and paste into the Substack editor (it will render the formatting):
📋 Click to view HTML 
${(($json.content || $json.contentSnippet || '').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>'))}

Don't forget to set the canonical URL in Substack story settings:
${$json.link}

` }}
